module_summary: Glitch-free runtime-configurable integer clock divider: a load FSM gates the clock while a cycle counter drives toggle flip-flops whose outputs are XORed/muxed for odd/even division, with bypass and an output clock gate.

anchors.name: clk_gate_state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/LOAD_DIV/WAIT_END_PERIOD controller sequencing safe divider reload and gating.

anchors.name: div_valid_i
anchors.why: New divider value request; starts reload when value differs.

anchors.name: div_ready_o
anchors.why: Accepts divider value when unchanged or after loading in LOAD_DIV.

anchors.name: div_i
anchors.why: Requested division factor, normalized then loaded into divider register.

anchors.name: div_i_normalized
anchors.why: div_i with 0 mapped to 1; compared and loaded into div_q.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Output clock enable into glitch-free gate; idles counter when off.

anchors.name: test_mode_en_i
anchors.why: Test mode forces bypass mux to pass input clock and gate test enable.

anchors.name: div_q
anchors.why: Current divider value setting counter wrap and toggle points.

anchors.name: cycle_cntr_q
anchors.why: Input-clock cycle counter wrapping at div-1; times toggle flip-flops.

anchors.name: cycle_counter_en
anchors.why: FSM enable stopping counter when output disabled.

anchors.name: cycl_count_o
anchors.why: Exposes internal cycle counter for phase alignment.

anchors.name: clk_div_bypass_en_q
anchors.why: Divide-by-1 bypass: selects clk_i at output mux, disables counter/T-FFs.

anchors.name: use_odd_division_q
anchors.why: Selects odd (XOR of T-FFs) or even clock and toggle timing.

anchors.name: toggle_ffs_en
anchors.why: FSM enable gating both toggle flip-flops during reload.

anchors.name: t_ff1_en
anchors.why: Toggle enable at counter compare points for first T-FF.

anchors.name: t_ff1_q
anchors.why: Posedge toggle flip-flop forming even divided clock.

anchors.name: t_ff2_q
anchors.why: Negedge toggle flip-flop XORed with t_ff1 for odd division.

anchors.name: generated_clock
anchors.why: Odd/even mux output feeding the bypass mux.

anchors.name: gate_en_q
anchors.why: Registered FSM gate enable, ANDed with en_i at clock gate.

anchors.name: gate_is_open_q
anchors.why: Output-clock-domain gate state; FSM waits for gate closed before reload.

anchors.name: clk_o
anchors.why: Gated divided output clock from clock gate cell.

groups.name: Divider load FSM
groups.description: Handshakes new divider, gates clock, loads div_q and mode flags.

groups.name: Cycle counter
groups.description: Counts input cycles modulo div_q, cleared on reload.

groups.name: Toggle flip-flop clock generator
groups.description: Toggle FFs at counter points, XOR for odd, mux odd/even clock.

groups.name: Bypass and clock gate
groups.description: Bypass mux to clk_i and glitch-free gate driving clk_o.
